# appwrite_auth_jwt (Ephemeral Resource)

Mints a short-lived JWT for an Appwrite user. The token is never written to Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to mint the token for.

### Optional

- `duration_seconds` (Number) How long the token remains valid, in seconds. Defaults to the server's own default.
- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.
- `session_id` (String) Scope the token to a specific session. Defaults to the user's most recent session.

### Read-Only

- `jwt` (String, Sensitive) The encoded JWT.
